about: Water levels: USGS gauges, Bureau of Reclamation, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, NOAA water-level stations, California DWR, LCRA. Weather: National Weather Service. Water temperature: NASA MODIS Terra and Aqua (daily, 1 km) and USGS/NASA Landsat 8-9. Clarity, algae and ice: Copernicus Sentinel-2. Satellite data read from Microsoft Planetary Computer. Lake bed: GLOBathy (CC0) and USGS 3DEP / Copernicus GLO-30 terrain. Outlines: HydroLAKES (CC BY 4.0). Ramps: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Map: OpenFreeMap. Ice thickness: LakeScope ice model (lake heat budget, Stefan ice growth under snow, snow-ice, spring melt) driven by NOAA RCC-ACIS daily temperature and precipitation, NOAA NCEI daily wind and the National Weather Service forecast, corrected by the satellite ice and water-temperature views.
